purpose: Context KB for camt.056.001.08 FIToFIPaymentCancellationRequest auto-fixing. For each XML tag: datatype, mandatory, errors, possible_fixes.

iso_20022_rules.AssignerAssigneeMandatory: Assignment/Assgnr and Assignment/Assgne are both mandatory; a cancellation request must identify both the assigner and assignee.
iso_20022_rules.AssignmentIdMandatory: Assignment/Id is mandatory and uniquely identifies the cancellation assignment.
iso_20022_rules.AssignmentDateTimeMandatory: Assignment/CreDtTm is mandatory and records when the cancellation assignment was created.
iso_20022_rules.UnderlyingTxInfMandatory: At least one Undrlyg/TxInf occurrence must be present; each occurrence carries one cancellation request for one underlying payment.
iso_20022_rules.CancellationReasonMandatory: Each Undrlyg/TxInf must contain at least one CxlRsnInf occurrence describing why the cancellation is requested.
iso_20022_rules.OriginalIdentificationRequired: Each Undrlyg/TxInf must identify the original payment via OrgnlUETR, OrgnlTxId, OrgnlInstrId or OrgnlEndToEndId so the cancellation is processable.
iso_20022_rules.ControlDataConsistency: If CtrlData/NbOfTxs is present it must equal the number of Undrlyg/TxInf occurrences; if CtrlData/CtrlSum is present it must equal the sum of OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt values.
iso_20022_rules.ReasonCodeOrProprietary: CxlRsnInf/Rsn is a choice between Cd (ExternalCancellationReason1Code) and Prtry (Max35Text); exactly one may be present.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02) is mandatory for all CBPR+ messages and must precede the Document element.
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'camt.056.001.08' and match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' for camt.056 under CBPR+ SR2025.
AppHdr/Fr and AppHdr/To must contain a valid BIC8 or BIC11 (BICFI) when exchanged on the SWIFT network.
All DateTime fields (AppHdr/CreDt, Assgnmt/CreDtTm) must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format; the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden.
Each Undrlyg/TxInf SHOULD carry OrgnlUETR (UUID v4) to unambiguously identify the cancelled payment; OrgnlTxId is the fallback identifier.
Assignment/Assgnr and Assignment/Assgne must each resolve to an agent (Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI) or party; for FI cancellation both are normally agents.
CxlRsnInf/Rsn/Cd must be a valid ExternalCancellationReason code (e.g. DUPL, TECH, FRAD, CUST, AGNT, CURR, UPAY).
All text fields are limited to the FIN-X (SWIFT) character set; accented or non-permitted characters are not allowed.
CBPR+ permits a single underlying transaction per camt.056 message; multiple Undrlyg/TxInf occurrences should be split into separate messages.
AddtlInf is limited to Max105Text per occurrence and may repeat.
Original message identification (OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId) should reference the camt/pacs message being cancelled.

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ messages and wraps the camt.056 Document.

errors.description: AppHdr element is absent; CBPR+ mandates BusinessApplicationHeaderV02.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block before the <Document> element.
Ensure AppHdr contains Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc and CreDt.

tags.description: Sending MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a valid BIC8 or BIC11 when exchanged on SWIFT; normally the assigner agent BIC.

errors.description: Fr element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{Assgnr_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from Assgnmt/Assgnr/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters following ISO 9362.
Example valid BIC: DEUTDEFFXXX

tags.description: Receiving MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a valid BIC8 or BIC11 on SWIFT; normally the assignee agent BIC.

errors.description: To element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{Assgne_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from Assgnmt/Assgne/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI.

errors.description: AppHdr/To contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters following ISO 9362.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the Business Message assigned by the sender. For camt.056 it should equal Assgnmt/Id.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Copy the value of Assgnmt/Id and insert as <BizMsgIdr>{Assgnmt_Id}</BizMsgIdr>.
If Assgnmt/Id is also absent, generate a unique Max35Text value (e.g. CXL-YYYYMMDD-001).

errors.description: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr does not equal Document/FIToFIPmtCxlReq/Assgnmt/Id.
possible_fixes: Read Assgnmt/Id and set BizMsgIdr to the same value.
If BizMsgIdr is authoritative, update Assgnmt/Id to match.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the value to a maximum of 35 characters preserving a meaningful unique prefix.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the assignment (Assgnmt/Id). Max 35 characters.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Id is absent.
possible_fixes: Add <Id>UNIQUE-ASSIGNMENT-ID</Id> inside <Assgnmt>.
Generate a Max35Text identifier such as 'CXLREQ-YYYYMMDD-001'.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must exactly match the Document namespace identifier and equal 'camt.056.001.08'.

errors.description: MsgDefIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgDefIdr>camt.056.001.08</MsgDefIdr> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document xmlns namespace identifier (camt.056.001.08).
possible_fixes: Read the xmlns attribute from the Document root element (urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.056.001.08).
Set MsgDefIdr to 'camt.056.001.08' with no trailing spaces or version mismatch.

tags.description: Business Service identifier. For camt.056 under CBPR+ SR2025 it must be 'swift.cbprplus.02'.

errors.description: BizSvc is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.02</BizSvc> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: BizSvc contains an incorrect value for camt.056 CBPR+.
possible_fixes: Replace value with 'swift.cbprplus.02' as mandated for camt.056 under CBPR+ SR2025.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the Business Message. Must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format; the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDt>{current datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 format}</CreDt> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under CBPR+.
AppHdr/CreDt has no timezone offset; CBPR+ requires an explicit +HH:MM offset.

tags.description: Unique identification of the cancellation assignment, assigned by the assigner. Should equal AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Id is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Id>{unique identifier up to 35 chars}</Id> as first child of Assgnmt.
Use the value of AppHdr/BizMsgIdr, or generate format CXL-YYYYMMDD-NNN.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Id exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to a maximum of 35 characters preserving the unique prefix.
Synchronize the truncated value to AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

tags.description: Party or agent assigning the cancellation case to the assignee. Choice of Agt (BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification) or Pty; for FI cancellations Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI is used.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Assgnr is absent; the assigner is mandatory.
possible_fixes: Insert <Assgnr><Agt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{assigner_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Agt></Assgnr> inside Assgnmt.
Harvest the BICFI from AppHdr/Fr if the assigner is the sending institution.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Assgnr/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI (8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters, ISO 9362).

tags.description: Party or agent to which the cancellation case is assigned. Choice of Agt (BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification) or Pty; for FI cancellations Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI is used.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Assgne is absent; the assignee is mandatory.
possible_fixes: Insert <Assgne><Agt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{assignee_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Agt></Assgne> inside Assgnmt.
Harvest the BICFI from AppHdr/To if the assignee is the receiving institution.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Assgne/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI (8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters, ISO 9362).

tags.description: Date and time the cancellation assignment was created. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; 'Z' suffix and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: Assgnmt/CreDtTm is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDtTm> inside Assgnmt.

errors.description: Assgnmt/CreDtTm uses 'Z' suffix; forbidden under CBPR+.
Assgnmt/CreDtTm has no timezone offset; CBPR+ requires an explicit +HH:MM offset.

tags.description: Identification of the investigation case linked to the cancellation request. Optional; present when the cancellation is tracked as a case.

errors.description: Case/Id exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate Case/Id to a maximum of 35 characters.

tags.description: Party that created the investigation case. Mandatory only when the Case block is present (Case requires both Id and Cretr).

errors.description: Case block is present but Cretr is absent; a Case requires both Id and Cretr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Cretr><Agt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{creator_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Agt></Cretr> inside Case.
Alternatively remove the whole Case block if no investigation case applies.

tags.description: Number of individual cancellation transactions. If present, must equal the count of Undrlyg/TxInf occurrences. CBPR+ allows a single underlying transaction (value = 1).

errors.description: CtrlData/NbOfTxs does not equal the actual number of Undrlyg/TxInf occurrences.
possible_fixes: Count all Undrlyg/TxInf occurrences and set NbOfTxs to that count.
For CBPR+ single-transaction messages, ensure NbOfTxs = 1.

errors.description: CtrlData/NbOfTxs contains non-numeric characters.
possible_fixes: Replace with a numeric integer string (max 15 digits). Example: '1'.

tags.description: Total of all individual amounts being cancelled. If present, must equal the sum of all Undrlyg/TxInf/OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt values.

errors.description: CtrlData/CtrlSum does not equal the sum of all OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt values.
possible_fixes: Sum all OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt values and set CtrlSum to the result.
For a single underlying transaction, CtrlSum should equal that OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt.
Remove CtrlSum if it is not required, to avoid a mismatch.

tags.description: Transaction information for the underlying payment to cancel. At least one occurrence is mandatory. Each occurrence SHOULD carry OrgnlUETR or OrgnlTxId and at least one CxlRsnInf.

errors.description: No Undrlyg/TxInf occurrence is present; at least one is mandatory.
possible_fixes: Insert at least one <TxInf> block inside <Undrlyg> identifying the original payment.
Include OrgnlUETR (or OrgnlTxId) and at least one CxlRsnInf.

errors.description: Undrlyg/TxInf carries no original payment identifier (OrgnlUETR, OrgnlTxId, OrgnlInstrId or OrgnlEndToEndId); the cancellation is not processable.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlUETR>{UUID v4 of the cancelled payment}</OrgnlUETR> inside TxInf.
Alternatively insert <OrgnlTxId>{original transaction id}</OrgnlTxId>.

tags.description: Identification of the cancellation request assigned by the assigner. Optional but recommended for tracking.

errors.description: CxlId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate CxlId to a maximum of 35 characters preserving the unique prefix.

tags.note: Mandatory within OrgnlGrpInf when the OrgnlGrpInf block is present.
tags.description: Original message identification (GrpHdr/MsgId) of the message that contained the payment being cancelled.

errors.description: OrgnlGrpInf block is present but OrgnlMsgId is absent; it is mandatory within OrgnlGrpInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlMsgId>{MsgId of the original payment message}</OrgnlMsgId> as first child of OrgnlGrpInf.
Remove the OrgnlGrpInf block entirely if the original message id is unknown and identification is by OrgnlUETR.

errors.description: OrgnlMsgId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate OrgnlMsgId to a maximum of 35 characters.

tags.note: Mandatory within OrgnlGrpInf when the OrgnlGrpInf block is present.
tags.description: Message name identifier (MsgDefIdr) of the original payment message being cancelled, e.g. pacs.008.001.08 or pacs.009.001.08.

errors.description: OrgnlGrpInf block is present but OrgnlMsgNmId is absent; it is mandatory within OrgnlGrpInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlMsgNmId>{original message type e.g. pacs.008.001.08}</OrgnlMsgNmId> inside OrgnlGrpInf.
Use the MsgDefIdr of the original payment (e.g. pacs.008.001.08, pacs.009.001.08).

tags.description: Original instruction identification (PmtId/InstrId) of the payment being cancelled.

errors.description: OrgnlInstrId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate OrgnlInstrId to a maximum of 35 characters to match the original instruction id.

tags.description: Original end-to-end identification (PmtId/EndToEndId) of the payment being cancelled.

errors.description: OrgnlEndToEndId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate OrgnlEndToEndId to a maximum of 35 characters to match the original end-to-end id.

tags.description: Original transaction identification (PmtId/TxId) of the payment being cancelled. Primary fallback identifier when OrgnlUETR is absent.

errors.description: OrgnlTxId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate OrgnlTxId to a maximum of 35 characters to match the original transaction id.

errors.description: Neither OrgnlTxId nor OrgnlUETR is present; the cancellation cannot be reliably matched to the original payment.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlUETR>{UUID v4 of original payment}</OrgnlUETR> (preferred), or <OrgnlTxId>{original transaction id}</OrgnlTxId>.

tags.description: Original UETR of the payment being cancelled. UUID v4 format. Strongly recommended under CBPR+ to unambiguously identify the cancelled payment.

errors.description: OrgnlUETR is not a valid UUID v4 (wrong format, uppercase, wrong version digit, or invalid variant).
possible_fixes: Ensure OrgnlUETR is lowercase hex in format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (y in 8,9,a,b).
The 13th character (version) must be '4'; total length must be exactly 36 characters including hyphens.
Convert any uppercase hex characters to lowercase.

errors.description: OrgnlUETR is absent; CBPR+ strongly recommends carrying the original UETR to identify the cancelled payment.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlUETR>{UUID v4 of the original payment}</OrgnlUETR> inside TxInf.
If the UETR is genuinely unavailable, ensure OrgnlTxId is provided instead.

tags.description: Original interbank settlement amount with currency attribute (Ccy) of the payment being cancelled. Used for matching and CtrlSum reconciliation.

errors.description: OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt is present but the Ccy attribute is missing.
possible_fixes: Add the Ccy attribute with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter currency code.
Example: <OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy="EUR">{amount}</OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt>

errors.description: OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy attribute is not a valid ISO 4217 currency code.
possible_fixes: Replace Ccy with a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).
Ensure the amount and currency match the original payment being cancelled.

tags.description: Original interbank settlement date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD) of the payment being cancelled.

errors.description: OrgnlIntrBkSttlmDt is not in date-only YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. includes a time component, Z suffix, or slashes).
possible_fixes: Use date-only format YYYY-MM-DD with no time component. Example: 2026-05-30.
Remove any time, 'Z' suffix or timezone offset from the date value.

tags.description: Cancellation reason information. At least one occurrence is mandatory per TxInf; contains optional Orgtr, optional Rsn (Cd or Prtry) and optional AddtlInf.

errors.description: No CxlRsnInf occurrence is present in Undrlyg/TxInf; at least one is mandatory.
possible_fixes: Insert at least one <CxlRsnInf><Rsn><Cd>DUPL</Cd></Rsn></CxlRsnInf> inside TxInf.
Choose the reason code that matches the cancellation cause (e.g. DUPL, FRAD, TECH, CUST).

tags.description: Party that originated the cancellation request. Optional; identifies the entity requesting the cancellation (agent or party).

errors.description: CxlRsnInf/Orgtr identifies an agent whose BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace the originator BICFI with a valid ISO 9362 BIC (8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters).
Alternatively identify the originator by Nm and PstlAdr instead of a BIC.

tags.description: Cancellation reason code from the ExternalCancellationReason code set. Mutually exclusive with Prtry. DUPL=duplicate, TECH=technical, FRAD=fraud, CUST=requested by customer, AGNT=requested by agent, CURR=incorrect currency, UPAY=undue payment.

errors.description: CxlRsnInf/Rsn/Cd contains a value not in the ExternalCancellationReason code set.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid cancellation reason code: DUPL, TECH, FRAD, CUST, AGNT, CURR or UPAY.
If the reason is not in the external code set, move the value into Rsn/Prtry instead.

errors.description: Both Rsn/Cd and Rsn/Prtry are present; Rsn is a choice and only one may be used.
possible_fixes: Keep either Rsn/Cd (preferred, from the code set) or Rsn/Prtry and remove the other.
Prefer the standard Cd value when an equivalent code exists.

tags.description: Proprietary cancellation reason used when no suitable external code exists. Mutually exclusive with Rsn/Cd.

errors.description: CxlRsnInf/Rsn/Prtry exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate Rsn/Prtry to a maximum of 35 characters.
Where possible, replace with a standard Rsn/Cd value instead of a proprietary reason.

tags.description: Further details on the cancellation reason. May repeat; each occurrence limited to 105 characters and the FIN-X character set.

errors.description: An AddtlInf occurrence exceeds 105 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the AddtlInf value to a maximum of 105 characters.
Split overflowing text into an additional AddtlInf occurrence.

errors.description: AddtlInf contains characters outside the permitted FIN-X / SWIFT character set.
possible_fixes: Replace accented or non-permitted characters with ASCII equivalents.
Encode '<' as '<' and '>' as '>' where used in text.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest Assgnmt/Id and set BizMsgIdr to the same value, or vice versa.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'camt.056.001.08' and match the Document namespace
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set MsgDefIdr to camt.056.001.08, matching the Document xmlns identifier.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Assgnmt must contain both Assgnr and Assgne
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert the missing Assgnr or Assgne agent block; harvest BICs from AppHdr/Fr and AppHdr/To respectively.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Each Undrlyg/TxInf SHOULD carry OrgnlUETR or OrgnlTxId so the cancellation is processable
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert OrgnlUETR (preferred) or OrgnlTxId identifying the original payment.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Each Undrlyg/TxInf must contain at least one CxlRsnInf
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert at least one CxlRsnInf with a Rsn/Cd value (e.g. DUPL).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CtrlData/NbOfTxs must equal the count of Undrlyg/TxInf occurrences when present
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Count Undrlyg/TxInf occurrences and update NbOfTxs.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CtrlData/CtrlSum must equal the sum of all OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt values when present
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Sum the OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt values and update CtrlSum, or remove CtrlSum.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CxlRsnInf/Rsn is a choice: Cd and Prtry are mutually exclusive
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Keep only one of Cd or Prtry; prefer the standard Cd value.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: OrgnlGrpInf, when present, must contain both OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add the missing OrgnlMsgId or OrgnlMsgNmId, or remove the OrgnlGrpInf block entirely.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Case, when present, must contain both Id and Cretr
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add the missing Case/Id or Case/Cretr, or remove the whole Case block.

schema_mapping_notes.assignment_block: Assgnmt (Assignment) replaces the GrpHdr concept of payment messages: it carries Id, Assgnr, Assgne and CreDtTm and is mandatory [1..1].
schema_mapping_notes.underlying_block: Undrlyg (UnderlyingTransaction4) is [1..n]; each contains TxInf [1..n] (PaymentTransaction106) referencing the original payment to cancel.
schema_mapping_notes.original_identification: Original payment identifiers (OrgnlInstrId, OrgnlEndToEndId, OrgnlTxId, OrgnlUETR) mirror the pacs.008/pacs.009 PmtId elements (InstrId, EndToEndId, TxId, UETR).
schema_mapping_notes.reason_codeset: CxlRsnInf/Rsn/Cd uses the ExternalCancellationReason1Code external code set (e.g. DUPL, TECH, FRAD, CUST, AGNT, CURR, UPAY); Prtry is the proprietary fallback.
schema_mapping_notes.bizsvc_value: For camt.056 under CBPR+ SR2025 the AppHdr/BizSvc value is 'swift.cbprplus.02'.
schema_mapping_notes.control_data: CtrlData (NbOfTxs, CtrlSum) is optional [0..1]; when present it must reconcile with the Undrlyg/TxInf occurrences and OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt values.
